sla.sql:
SELECT CAST(r.data_sla AS date) AS day,a.base_code,a.base_name,a.manager,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.no_prazo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS numerator,SUM(1) AS denominator
           FROM public.entregas r JOIN jarvis.base_assignments a
           ON a.base_code=CAST(r.codigo_base AS text)
           AND CAST(r.data_sla AS date)>=a.valid_from AND CAST(r.data_sla AS date)<=a.valid_to
           WHERE a.regional=:rm AND CAST(r.data_sla AS date) BETWEEN :start AND :end
           AND (CAST(:base AS text) IS NULL OR a.base_code=:base)
           AND (CAST(:manager AS text) IS NULL OR a.manager=:manager) 
           GROUP BY CAST(r.data_sla AS date),a.base_code,a.base_name,a.manager
           ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 20001

shipping.sql:
SELECT CAST(r.data AS date) AS day,a.base_code,a.base_name,a.manager,
           SUM((r.etapa_6_h+r.etapa_7_h+r.etapa_8_h)*r.pacotes) AS numerator,SUM(r.pacotes) AS denominator
           FROM public.shipping_time_diario r JOIN jarvis.base_assignments a
           ON a.base_code=CAST(r.codigo_base AS text)
           AND CAST(r.data AS date)>=a.valid_from AND CAST(r.data AS date)<=a.valid_to
           WHERE a.regional=:rm AND CAST(r.data AS date) BETWEEN :start AND :end
           AND (CAST(:base AS text) IS NULL OR a.base_code=:base)
           AND (CAST(:manager AS text) IS NULL OR a.manager=:manager)  AND r.etapa_6_h IS NOT NULL AND r.etapa_7_h IS NOT NULL AND r.etapa_8_h IS NOT NULL
           GROUP BY CAST(r.data AS date),a.base_code,a.base_name,a.manager
           ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 20001

avaria.sql:
SELECT CAST(CAST(r.fechada_em AS date) AS date) AS day,a.base_code,a.base_name,a.manager,
           SUM(r.valor_centavos) AS numerator,SUM(1) AS denominator
           FROM public.jt_arbitragem_ocorrencias r JOIN jarvis.base_assignments a
           ON a.base_code=CAST(r.codigo_base AS text)
           AND CAST(CAST(r.fechada_em AS date) AS date)>=a.valid_from AND CAST(CAST(r.fechada_em AS date) AS date)<=a.valid_to
           WHERE a.regional=:rm AND CAST(CAST(r.fechada_em AS date) AS date) BETWEEN :start AND :end
           AND (CAST(:base AS text) IS NULL OR a.base_code=:base)
           AND (CAST(:manager AS text) IS NULL OR a.manager=:manager)  AND r.tipo=:claim AND UPPER(TRIM(r.status)) IN ('PROCESSO ENCERRADO','ARBITRAGEM FINALIZADA')
           GROUP BY CAST(CAST(r.fechada_em AS date) AS date),a.base_code,a.base_name,a.manager
           ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 20001
